Your own mother, holy @wDN{Inana}, has let you sit with her on the holy ……. …… she is the Mistress. She has let you ……. She has called you by a good name. …… joyfully in your ……. …… dwells ……; the lord shines forth in its midst. @gap{1 line fragmentary} @wDN{Šara}, you ……, praying in the good and holy ……. ……, the princely son, grandiloquent …… holy ……, coming forth like the sun from the shrine @wTN{E-maḫ}.
